1.Nf3 c5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3.strategy: Develops the queen's knight with a purpose: it backs up the c4 pawn, watches d5 and e4 and prepares a later d-pawn break. White commits nothing on the kingside yet, so the choice between a fianchetto and a central clash stays open.

1.Nf3 c5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Nf6.strategy: Develops the king's knight towards the centre and fights for d5 and e4, mirroring White's piece development. With the e-pawn on e6 Black keeps both a quick strike in the centre and a slower, compact set-up available, and asks White which game to play.
